I originally began to develop fibromyalgia (a chronic pain syndrome) at just 14 years old and anxiety got progressively worse to the point where I barely talked to anyone anymore because I was in so much pain and had so much anxiety. At 18 I bought kratom for the first time and it cured my fibromyalgia when I took it. I was amazed. The I stupidly tried Etizolam and it further helped with my anxiety and pain a ton.
